decisions.reason: The margin analysis builds on the established market-data offer and still had its own page in 2024, so its results appear to meet aspiration, and in a growing industry the firm has the slack to keep it.

Its drop from a dedicated page to a mere mention, while sibling tariff products B, D and F were already withdrawn, points to a shortfall, but it sits close to the core tariff-calculation business at low marginal cost, so carrying it another year is cheaper than redeploying its resources.

Its visibility declined, but the area definition tool is a supporting component for the location-based tariff and margin products on the central platform, so the firm keeps it as integrated functionality rather than starting problemistic search for other uses of its resources.
